{{Quote|If a thing is lost, it can be found. If a person is lost, he must find himself.|Spintiri proverb|<ref name="LotL" />}}
'''Spintir''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that was home to a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] temple known as the [[Dawn Temple]], and an unusually high number of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]].<ref name="LotL" /> Spintir was a wealthy trade world.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
